name: Nishigōshi (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Nishigōshi town emblem in white: a disc with a pointed top and a white notch, like a stylised letter C.
history: Flag of the former town of Nishigōshi in Kumamoto Prefecture, dissolved on 2006-02-27.

features.role: Nishigōshi town emblem — a disc with a pointed top and a white notch, like a stylised letter C
